description: Illustrative single-row instance of the gate-obligation contract: the obligations an enforcer owes before it can be relied on. Shape only — the live registry is IP-track and not mirrored here. Exists so the contract itself is exercised by test:schemas (§0.18 example slot).

obligations.requirement: Every domain-spanning enforcer is enrolled in the enforcer-scope registry — either declared-only with its identifier and script, or covered with scope markers proving it spans its full declared domain and narrowings that would re-blind it are forbidden.
obligations.failure_symptom: N domain-spanning gate(s) are NOT enrolled (ceiling 0)
obligations.authoring_note: A forbidden narrowing must name something that shrinks the POPULATION a verdict ranges over — never something that only trims the failure OUTPUT. Banning a display truncation makes correct code illegal and forces the next author to obfuscate a working line.
